# monotaur_variable (Data Source)

Reads a single Monotaur variable by its ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "monotaur_variable" "threshold" {
  id = "01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the variable to look up.

### Read-Only

- `create_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the variable was created.
- `description` (String) An optional description of the variable.
- `monitor_id` (String) The ID of the monitor this variable belongs to.
- `name` (String) The name of the variable.
- `update_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the variable was last updated.
- `value` (String) The value of the variable.
